thread:
leo_pm: Pushed another small update to the routing policies editor frames. Main asks: make priority ordering intuitive, fix the ambiguous validation copy, and ensure keyboard reordering is fully accessible.
anya_ui: Saw it. My first thought 12: replace the current line-based chevrons with a compact numeric badge (1,2,3) that stays visible. That should cue the order without extra chrome.
trent_frontend: Numeric badge is great. Implementation Q: should the badge be editable inline? If so we need validation for duplicates and non-integers.
yasmin_uxresearch: In sessions people tried typing priorities rather than dragging. They expect quick edit. Recommend inline edit with immediate validation: show error state under the field: "Must be a unique integer".
leo_pm: Good. Keep drag for power users but allow inline edit. Also we need clearer tie-breaker language 5: folks think larger numbers mean higher priority. Propose: "Lower number = evaluated first (1 before 2)."
anya_ui: I'll try two label styles: (A) Short: "Priority: lower numbers run first." (B) Help: "Lower numbers are evaluated before higher numbers (1 runs before 2). If equal, top-to-bottom order applies." Adding the short sibling copy under the header as muted helper text.
trent_frontend: For duplicate priorities, let's show an inline chip: "Conflict with Rule 'Add VAT' 12" and a small 'fix' menu with options: "Move rule up" / "De-dupe by renumber". Also will add aria-live updates on renumber: `aria-live=\"polite\"` announces "Priority for 'X' set to 2".
yasmin_uxresearch: Screen reader suggestion: when dragging completes, announce position: "Rule 'X' moved to position 2 of 6." Also provide keyboard-only controls: a tiny vertical ellipsis menu with Move up / Move down actions, exposed to keyboard and SR.
anya_ui: On focus states: reveal the drag handle and the move chevrons. For touch, show a persistent handle. I'll include a microprototype in Figma.
leo_pm: Validation copy needs to be prescriptive. Avoid "Rule conflict" alone. Use: "Conflict with rule 'Y' 12: both match this input. Resolve by reordering or editing conditions." That text should appear inline and also be readable by screen readers via `aria-describedby`.
trent_frontend: Implementation detail: we'll reuse the virtualized list from infra-console. For renumber flows I'll add optimistic UI and background dedupe job; show a toast: "Renumber applied" but keep the inline hint visible if any conflicts remain.
deploy-bot: Preview deploy: https://deploy-previews.redwood.sh/1852-priority-nudge (+ E2E branch: feature/routing-priority).
leo_pm: Can you post the Figma link + exact helper copy and aria strings here when ready? I'll schedule a short review w/eng tomorrow.
anya_ui: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/Routing-Policies-Priority-1849-proto
Helper copy variants: "Priority: lower numbers run first." and "Lower numbers are evaluated before higher numbers (1 runs before 2). If numbers match, top-to-bottom order is used as a tiebreaker."
ARIA snippets I want wired:
- container: role=\"list\" aria-label=\"Routing rules\"
- row: role=\"listitem\" aria-label=\"Rule <name>\" aria-posinset=\"<pos>\" aria-setsize=\"<total>\"
- drag control: role=\"button\" aria-label=\"Drag to reorder\" aria-grabbed=\"false\"
- move actions: role=\"button\" aria-label=\"Move rule up\" / \"Move rule down\"
- live announcements: role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"
trent_frontend: I'll wire those attributes and add unit tests for the keyboard move actions. Also adding a 500ms debounce on preview runs to avoid flurries.
yasmin_uxresearch: Quick microcopy tweak: for the inline conflict hint use: "Conflict with 'Y' 12 013 Affects matching order; fix by reordering or changing conditions." Keep it short.
leo_pm: Perfect. Thanks team. If anything in the preview URL looks broken, drop screenshots here. Otherwise I'll mark as ready for canary gating after tomorrow's eng review. :white_check_mark:
